subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 6: English in action – Asking the way
outcomes: Understand and give directions: turn left, turn right, go straight ahead.
Follow directions on a map to find a place.

tf.s: We start with 'Excuse me' when we ask the way.
The opposite of 'turn left' is 'turn right'.
tf.why: Correct! Left and right are opposites.

tf.s: Razan wants to go to the museum.
tf.why: Razan wants to go to the park.

tf.s: You turn right at the supermarket to go to the park.
tf.why: Well done! Turn right at the supermarket.

tf.s: The park is on the right.
tf.why: The park is on the left.

tf.s: A chemist, a bank and a cinema are places in a town.
tf.why: Great! They are buildings on the map.

tf.s: You can buy medicine at a cinema.
tf.why: You buy medicine at a chemist.

tf.s: We say 'Can you tell me the way to the park, please?'
'Go across the road' means walk next to the road for a long time.
tf.why: 'Go across' means from one side to the other. 'Go along' means next to it.

boxes.q: What does 'go along the road' mean?
Where do you begin on the map?

boxes.why: We say 'turn right at the supermarket'.

boxes.q: Complete: Excuse me, can you ___ me the way to the park, please?
Which is a building on the map?
boxes.why: A museum is a building in town.

boxes.q: Which word tells you to change direction?
Where can you eat a meal?
Someone asks you the way. You start with...
Ask the way to the bank.
o: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the bank, please?

hunt.q: Go ___ the road (to the other side)

mcq.q: Who wants to go to the park?
mcq.why: Razan wants to go to the park.
The park is on the left.

mcq.q: Which word do you say first to be polite?
Which place has old things to see?
Put in order: (a) The park is on the left. (b) Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the park, please? (c) Sure. Turn right at the supermarket.
You walk from one side of the road to the other. Which direction is it?
mcq.why: 'Across' means from one side to the other.

mcq.q: You want the cinema. Which question is correct?
o: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the cinema, please?
Excuse me, can you tell me the cinema way?
Can you say me the way to the cinema?

mcq.q: Your partner turned right, not left. What happens?
o: He arrives at the wrong place.
He arrives at the right place.
mcq.why: One wrong turn takes you to a different place.

mcq.q: Why do we begin at 'Start' each time on the map?
o: So everyone follows the directions from the same place.
mcq.why: Directions only work from the right starting point.

mcq.q: Which directions are the best to answer a friend?
o: Go straight ahead. Turn left. The library is on the right.
mcq.why: Clear steps help your friend find the place.
